real: A giant energy company vanishes — its books were fake and its executives are arrested
source: 2001 — Enron, one of America's largest energy companies, collapsed after years of accounting fraud, becoming the largest corporate bankruptcy in U.S. history and triggering the Sarbanes-Oxley Act.
fakes: Energy giant reports record quarterly earnings
Executives celebrate a merger with a rival utility
Investors praise the company's bold new strategy

real: A 'medical breakthrough' company turns out to have been a multi-year lie
source: 2018 — Theranos, the billion-dollar blood-testing startup led by Elizabeth Holmes, was exposed for faking its technology; it collapsed and Holmes was convicted of fraud.
fakes: Startup unveils a new blood test that uses a single drop
Investors pour billions into the medical device firm
Founder named one of the most influential young entrepreneurs

real: A 'we work' real-estate giant valued at $47 billion turns out to be running at a huge loss
source: WeWork — the co-working 'revolution' reached a $47 billion valuation before its failed 2019 IPO exposed a company that had been burning cash for years with no clear path to profit.
fakes: Co-working firm files for a record public offering
Company rebrands its office spaces across major cities
Founder shares a vision of reimagining the workplace

real: A $1.75 billion streaming service is shut down after just six months
source: Quibi — a short-form streaming service backed by Hollywood stars and major investors launched in 2020 and was shut down just six months later after failing to gain a meaningful audience.
fakes: Streaming startup debuts with a lineup of celebrity originals
Company bets big on short, vertical video for phones
Investors back a new entrant in the crowded market

real: A luxury 'paradise' festival for the rich turns out to be a complete scam
source: 2017 — the Fyre Festival: a high-society music festival in the Bahamas promised luxury to its attendees but delivered cardboard walls, a collapsed hotel, and no food — and its promoter was later sentenced to prison.
fakes: Billionaire-adjacent crowd arrives at a remote island party
Promoters tout the festival's lavish new amenities
Celebrities share glamorous photos from the beach

real: A best-selling airplane is grounded worldwide after two fatal crashes
source: The Boeing 737 MAX — two crashes in 2018 and 2019, linked to a faulty flight-control system, led to a global grounding of the type and billions in compensation for Boeing.
fakes: Airline orders a new batch of the popular narrow-body jet
Regulators approve the aircraft for commercial service
Airlines race to adopt the fuel-efficient model

real: A giant auto maker is caught cheating on emissions tests worldwide
source: 2015 — the Volkswagen emissions scandal: the company was found to have used software to cheat pollution tests on diesel cars, affecting millions of vehicles and triggering a global recall.
fakes: Auto giant unveils a new line of clean diesel models
Regulators tighten fuel-economy standards for new cars
Engineers claim the vehicles meet all safety tests
